# Part 14 · Ads in AI: Four Placements, One Label

**AI Product** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DdY-d--R0UW/) · Published 17 Sep 2026

> How does a paid product end up inside an AI assistant's answer?

You ask an AI assistant which laptop to buy and it names one. A sponsored product can get into that answer four ways, and a "Sponsored" label only works on one of them.

![Whiteboard for Part 14](canvas.jpg)

## The three rules

1. Know the four placements: a slot under the answer, an item in the list, a retrieved page, a line in the system prompt. Only the slot leaves the answer unchanged.
2. Building an assistant: write down what the model is never paid to say, and run a replay with the sponsor removed, before the ad slot exists.
3. Using one: ask two assistants the same question. It isn't proof, but it's the check on your side.

## The template

[`commercial-context-contract.md`](commercial-context-contract.md). A one-page template: which placements are open, what the model is never paid to say, and the replay that checks it.
